title: AMAZING SUBSCRIPTION
text: Got my first box and loved it!! Some sample and some full size items were included. The Seed Facial Moisturizer is AMAZING! Never would I have found out about this amazing moisturizer without this box. Also recieved a full size eyeshadow pallet that had perfect tones for me as a natural red head. There were shampoo and conditioner samples as well and a lip gloss that is a great color and smells so good. Absolutely loved it! Looking forward to my next box for sure and might even sign up for the quarterly one as well!
label: positive
